title: Immediate Effect of Proponent-Nasal-Spray on Unspecific Discomfort in the Nose
brief_summary: Investigation of the immediate effect on subjective relief of symptoms by Proponent - Nasal - Spray after a one time administration (following a single dose administration in each nostril) in an open, not randomised, non-blinded single centre observation study on 40 volunteers between 18-75 years of age with an unspecific discomfort in the nose such as enhanced nasal discharge/ secretion (runny nose), congested nose, sneezing, itchy nose or feeling of a dry nose.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Key inclusion criteria are one or more of the following symptoms:

* nasal discharge/ secretion (runny nose)
* congested nose
* sneezing
* itchy nose
* feeling of a dry nose

Exclusion Criteria:

Key exclusion criteria:

* \<18 years of age
* 75 years of age
condition: Unspecified Disorder of Nose and Nasal Sinuses
